meta.summary: A tabletop fantasy adventure with an AI dungeon master. The playable loop is in private beta on TestFlight; real fifth-edition rules are next.

milestones.name: The Door
milestones.blurb: A playable loop: forge a hero, gather a party, vote through AI-written scenes.

milestones.name: The Gatehouse
milestones.blurb: On real phones: live server, database and TestFlight builds.

milestones.name: The Dragon's Perch
milestones.blurb: A home screen worth opening: the living dragon, his voice and his temper.

milestones.name: The Armory
milestones.blurb: Real rules: fifth-edition stats, character generation, checks and combat.

milestones.name: The Master's Study
milestones.blurb: A deeper dungeon master: richer archetypes, pacing and memory.

milestones.name: The Hall of Voices
milestones.blurb: Speak in your hero's voice and hear the dungeon master narrate.

milestones.name: Daylight
milestones.blurb: Hardening, a friends beta, then the App Store.
